This full-size luxury SUV combines powerful performance with forward-thinking comfort. The 3.5L V6 DOHC 24-valve engine paired with 9-speed automatic transmission and 4-wheel drive delivers capable handling whether you're navigating city streets or highway drives. The three-row configuration provides flexible seating for up to eight passengers, with reclining third-row seats and split-folding rear seating that adapts to your cargo needs.

Every journey benefits from the comprehensive technology suite integrated throughout the cabin. The Google Built-in navigation system seamlessly connects with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the advanced Klipsch audio system transforms every drive into an immersive experience. Climate-controlled front bucket seats feature massage functionality to enhance comfort on longer trips, complemented by heated seats throughout the vehicle.

Safety and convenience features work together to support confident driving. The adaptive suspension system automatically adjusts to road conditions, while the heads-up display keeps critical information in your line of sight. Multiple airbags, electronic stability control, and INFINITI InTouch emergency communication provide layered protection for you and your passengers.

The sophisticated black exterior with premium paint reflects quality and distinction. Fully automatic headlights with delay-off capability enhance visibility, while power door mirrors with heating and the power moonroof add modern amenities. The 22-inch cast aluminum alloy wheels command attention and complement the vehicle's upscale appearance.

Experience the combination of luxury, capability, and technology that positions the 2025 INFINITI QX80 AUTOGRAPH as a distinguished choice for those seeking a three-row SUV that prioritizes comfort, refinement, and versatility. We invite you to schedule a time to explore this vehicle in detail.

description: 2021 Toyota Land Cruiser Heritage Build 56,396 Miles If you've been searching for a 200 Series Land Cruiser , you already know these aren't just SUVs—they're legends. The 2021 model represents the final year of the iconic 200 Series sold in the United States , making it one of the most desirable and collectible Land Cruisers ever produced. Known worldwide for their unmatched reliability, overbuilt engineering, and incredible off-road capability, clean, low-mileage examples like this have become increasingly difficult to find—and values continue to reflect it. This two-owner, Clean Carfax example has traveled just 56,396 miles and comes with an outstanding service history. Even more impressive, it has been professionally built using premium components throughout, with well over $20,000 invested in high-quality upgrades. No shortcuts, no cheap parts—just the right modifications from some of the best names in the industry. It is mechanically excellent, exceptionally clean, and needs absolutely nothing. Finished in Midnight Black Metallic over a luxurious Beige Terra Semi-Aniline Leather interior , this Land Cruiser offers the perfect combination of luxury, durability, and capability. Premium Suspension & Off-Road Performance The suspension was built to perform on and off the pavement while maintaining the refined ride quality Land Cruisers are known for. Up front you'll find a 2.5-inch Radflo Performance Suspension System featuring: Radflo 2.5 Remote Reservoir Coilovers Remote reservoir shocks for superior cooling and consistent damping SPC Upper Control Arms for proper alignment and improved suspension geometry Out back, it features: Radflo Remote Reservoir Rear Shocks Tuned for improved articulation, ride quality, and control over any terrain Whether you're exploring mountain trails, crossing desert terrain, or simply cruising the highway, this suspension transforms an already incredible platform into something truly exceptional. Expedition-Ready Front End The front of this Land Cruiser is equipped with one of the industry's most respected off-road protection systems: ARB Full Replacement Steel Front Bumper ARB Solis High-Performance LED Driving Lights Warn VR EVO Winch Synthetic Winch Rope Recovery-ready setup Not only does this dramatically improve protection and approach angle, but it also gives the truck an aggressive overland appearance while remaining fully functional. Premium Wheels & Tires The stance is exactly how a Land Cruiser should look. Genuine 20-inch TRD Pro BBS Forged Aluminum Wheels Factory gloss black finish 285/65R20 Yokohama Geolandar All-Terrain Tires The forged BBS wheels are lightweight, incredibly strong, and among the most sought-after factory Toyota wheels ever produced. Complete Exterior Transformation Every chrome accent has been professionally blacked out, creating a clean, modern appearance that perfectly complements the Midnight Black Metallic paint. Additional upgrades include: Gobi Expedition Roof Rack Integrated Rigid Industries LED Light Bar Gobi Rear Access Ladder Heavy-Duty Rock Sliders ARB Full Replacement Rear Bumper This isn't simply a lifted SUV—it's a purpose-built expedition vehicle that looks incredible from every angle. Built for Adventure This Land Cruiser is equipped with one of the most desirable onboard air systems available: ARB Dual Air Compressor System Perfect for: Airing tires up after the trail Running air tools General overlanding and recovery needs Under the hood you'll also find an aFe Momentum Cold Air Intake , providing improved airflow, enhanced throttle response, and a more aggressive induction sound. Legendary Toyota Reliability Power comes from Toyota's legendary 5.7L DOHC i-Force V8 , producing 381 horsepower and 401 lb-ft of torque , paired with an exceptionally smooth 8-speed automatic transmission and Toyota's legendary full-time four-wheel-drive system featuring a locking Torsen center differential. It also includes KDSS suspension, Multi-Terrain Select, Crawl Control, Hill-Start Assist Control, and Off-Road Turn Assist from the factory. This drivetrain has earned its reputation as one of the most dependable SUV powertrains ever built. Luxury Meets Capability While this Land Cruiser is built to tackle remote destinations, it's equally impressive inside. Finding one with: Only 56,396 miles Two-owner history Clean Carfax Excellent service records Over $20,000 invested in premium modifications Professionally built with ARB, Radflo, Warn, Gobi, BBS, Rigid Industries, SPC, aFe, and Yokohama components ...is even harder. This 2024 Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 in Gray represents the pinnacle of off-road capability combined with genuine performance. The SRT HEMI 6.4L V8 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers the power and control you need for any terrain, whether navigating challenging trails or commanding the highway.

Electronic Stability Control and traction control work seamlessly with the 4WD system to maintain control when conditions demand it.

The removable rear quarter windows and convertible hardtop give you flexibility to customize your driving experience. Dual front zone air conditioning with automatic temperature control ensures comfort in any climate. The heated front door mirrors and rear window defroster enhance visibility during challenging weather.

Technology integration keeps you connected with Uconnect 5 Navigation featuring a 12.3-inch display, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio. The nine-speaker audio system delivers quality sound, while steering wheel-mounted controls keep your focus on the road.

This Rubicon 392 Final Edition is ready to serve as your capable companion for work, adventure, and everyday driving. We invite you to visit and experience this distinctive vehicle firsthand.

The heated rear seats extend this consideration to back-row passengers. The Escalade Premium Luxury combines practical luxury appointments with genuine utility. The leather seating surfaces with heated and ventilated front seats extend comfort across all three rows, while the split-folding rear seat accommodates both passengers and cargo with flexibility. The all-weather floor liner package protects your investment against daily wear, and the integrated cargo liner simplifies cleanup whether you're hauling groceries or outdoor gear.

The 16.9-inch OLED screen connects seamlessly with your smartphone through wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while the navigation system guides you confidently. The AKG Studio audio system delivers concert-quality sound through 19 speakers, and SiriusXM 360L keeps you entertained coast to coast. The heated steering wheel and heads-up display reflect Cadillac's attention to driver comfort.

Safety features provide peace of mind for you and your passengers. Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist work together to help prevent collisions. Lane Change Alert monitors adjacent traffic during lane changes, while the rear camera mirror and reverse automatic braking add confidence during maneuvers. The vehicle inclination sensor and multiple airbags create comprehensive occupant protection.

This vehicle arrives as a one-owner, local trade-in with a clean CARFAX history. The lifetime warranty adds long-term value and security to your ownership experience. Combined with the engineering quality Cadillac delivers, this Escalade Premium Luxury stands ready to serve as both daily transportation and capable adventure companion.

We invite you to schedule a visit to experience this vehicle firsthand. Our team is prepared to answer your questions and arrange a test drive at your convenience.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.

description: Dressed in crisp White with a Black leather interior, this used 2024 Lexus GX is the kind of SUV that looks perfectly at home pulling up to a nice dinner—or pointing its nose toward the next weekend escape. Under the hood sits a twin-turbo 3.4L V6, paired with a smooth automatic transmission and full-time 4WD, giving you that confident, “go ahead, pick the interesting route” energy whether the forecast says sunshine or something messier.This GX feels substantial in the best way: solid suspension hardware, a composed ride, and the kind of steering and braking confidence that makes long drives feel easy. And when plans involve bringing more than just a duffel bag, it’s ready—thanks to serious towing capability with integrated sway control and the right connections already in place.Inside, it’s equal parts comfort and command center. You settle into leather, wrap your hands around a heated leather steering wheel, and let the cabin’s thoughtful design do the rest—real wood and metal-look accents where you want them, clear digital info where you need it, and the convenience of modern connectivity, navigation with voice activation, and a built-in mobile hotspot to keep the crew online. Technology integration prioritizes safety and convenience with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, Google built-in navigation capability, an interior camera, and OnStar Services capability. Rain-sensing wipers and fully automatic headlamps with LED technology adjust to conditions automatically, and the LED headlamps with daytime running lamps provide distinctive visibility.

Safety throughout the Suburban is comprehensive, featuring dual front impact airbags, side-impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel independent suspension with premium smooth ride tuning work to maintain composure and control. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide responsive stopping power.

This Suburban is ready to serve as the dependable foundation for your family's adventures and daily responsibilities. Visit us to experience how its blend of spacious design, accessible technology, and capable performance can fit your needs.

Introducing the 2026 BMW X6 xDrive40i M Sport in striking Brooklyn Grey Metallic—a sophisticated SUV that combines athletic performance with refined comfort for discerning drivers who demand excellence.

- Parking Assistance Package with Automatic Park Assistant, Active Park Distance Control, and 3D Surround View
- Premium Package featuring Remote Engine Start, Live Cockpit Pro navigation, and harman/kardon Surround Sound
- Climate Comfort Package with 4-Zone Automatic Climate Control and ventilated, multi-contour heated seats
- 3.0L DOHC turbocharged engine delivering balanced power with 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission
- All-Wheel Drive system engineered for confident handling in any driving condition
- Power moonroof and adaptive air suspension for a refined driving experience
- Advanced safety features including dual front airbags, Electronic Stability Control, and BMW Assist eCall
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with one-year trial subscription and Apple CarPlay compatibility
- 20-inch M Star-Spoke bicolor wheels and sport-tuned suspension
- Leather sport steering wheel with heated capability and memory settings
- Wireless device charging and premium connectivity through ConnectedDrive Services
- Power-adjustable front seats with lumbar support and driver memory functions
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror and rear spoiler for distinctive styling

This X6 delivers the dynamic capability you expect from the M Sport designation. The 3.0L engine with 8-Speed Automatic Sport transmission provides responsive performance while maintaining reasonable fuel efficiency at 22 city and 26 highway MPG. The all-wheel drive system ensures stability and traction across varied road conditions, while the adaptive air suspension adapts to your driving style and road surface for optimal comfort and control.

The interior reflects BMW's commitment to driver-focused design. Heated front seats with armrests and a heated steering wheel provide comfort during cold weather, while the 4-zone automatic climate control allows each passenger to maintain their preferred temperature. The multi-contour seats with ventilation technology offer support for longer journeys, and the leather sport steering wheel with mounted audio controls keeps essential functions within reach.

The parking assistance suite removes stress from tight situations. The automatic park assistant analyzes spaces, the 3D surround view provides complete visibility around the vehicle, and the backup assistant offers guidance when reversing. The rear parking camera displays a clear view on the Live Cockpit Pro display, making parking and maneuvering safer and more convenient.

Technology integration enhances every drive. Live Cockpit Pro delivers intuitive navigation and vehicle controls, while the harman/kardon surround sound system transforms your commute into an enjoyable audio experience. SiriusXM 360L provides satellite radio, music, news, and sports entertainment throughout your ownership. Apple CarPlay compatibility keeps your smartphone seamlessly integrated.

The 2026 BMW X6 xDrive40i M Sport is ready to become part of your lifestyle. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience its commanding presence, refined interior, and responsive handling firsthand.

This 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Z71 represents a commanding presence on the road, built for families and adventurers who refuse to compromise on capability or comfort.

- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with 10-Speed Automatic transmission
- 4WD with 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case and Hill Descent Control
- Power Panoramic Dual-Pane Sunroof with express-open and power sunshade
- Leather-Appointed Seating with 8-Way Power Front Passenger Seat Adjuster
- Heated Front and Second Row Outboard Seats with Memory Settings
- Bose 10-Speaker Surround Sound System with CenterPoint
- Google Built-in Navigation with Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- LED Animated Headlamps and Tail Lamps with Front Fog Lamps
- Heated and Power-Adjustable Outside Mirrors with Driver Auto-Dimming
- Second and Third Row 60/40 Power Split-Folding Bench Seats with Power Release
- Rear Power Liftgate and Wireless Phone Charging
- Z71 Exterior Features including Black Tubular Assist Steps and Red Recovery Hooks
- 20-inch Bright Machined Aluminum Wheels
- Dual Zone Automatic Climate Control with Rear Air Conditioning
- Premium Smooth Ride Suspension with Four-Wheel Independent Suspension

As a single-owner, local trade vehicle with minimal mileage, this Suburban has been meticulously maintained and remains in exceptional condition. The beige exterior is complemented by refined interior appointments, while the Z71 package adds rugged capability with specialized exterior styling and performance features designed for those who venture beyond conventional routes.

The Suburban delivers 14 city and 19 highway MPG, balancing the commanding performance of its V8 engine with reasonable fuel efficiency for a vehicle of this class. Comfortable seating for up to nine passengers, combined with flexible cargo configurations, makes this full-size SUV ideal for families requiring versatility and space without sacrificing refinement.

Inside, the cabin reflects a harmonious blend of luxury and practicality. Heated steering wheel, memory settings, and comprehensive climate control ensure every journey feels effortless. The advanced infotainment system integrates Google-powered navigation alongside SiriusXM with 360L, keeping you connected and entertained whether you're navigating city streets or remote terrain.

The Preferred Equipment Group 2Z7 and Comfort Package elevate this vehicle with premium conveniences such as power lumbar adjusters, heated mirrors, and the Bose audio system—details that transform daily driving into something more refined. Hill Descent Control and the robust suspension system provide confidence on challenging terrain, while multiple safety technologies, including OnStar Services capability and comprehensive airbag systems, protect your family on every drive.

We invite you to experience this 2025 Chevrolet Suburban Z71 firsthand. Contact us today to schedule your personal walk-around and test drive, and discover why this vehicle is the solution for those seeking full-size capability without compromise.

The 2025 Chevrolet Tahoe RST brings commanding presence and capability to every journey. Finished in striking Radiant Red Tintcoat with 22-inch polished aluminum wheels, this full-size SUV delivers the premium appearance and road presence that makes a statement. The RST trim emphasizes style with distinctive exterior features and refined detailing throughout.

Powered by the proven EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission, this four-wheel drive Tahoe balances performance with practical efficiency, achieving 15 city and 19 highway mpg. The premium smooth ride suspension and four-wheel independent suspension system work together to deliver composed handling whether you're navigating city streets or tackling varied terrain.

Inside, the Tahoe RST prioritizes comfort and connectivity for all passengers. The spacious interior features front bucket seats with 8-way power adjustment and heated capability, complemented by perforated leather seat trim. Three rows of seating accommodate up to nine passengers, with the third row featuring manual 60/40 split-folding design for flexible cargo configuration. The floor console provides convenient storage while color-keyed carpeting adds refined touches throughout.

Technology integration keeps you connected and in control. The 17.7-inch advanced color LCD display hosts the premium Chevrolet Infotainment 3 system with Google built-in navigation compatibility. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity work seamlessly with your devices, while wireless phone charging and multiple USB ports ensure your electronics stay powered. SiriusXM satellite radio with 360L trial subscription provides entertainment options for every preference.

Safety and convenience features are thoughtfully integrated throughout. Remote start allows you to prepare the vehicle before you leave home, while the universal home remote provides seamless garage door operation. The rear power liftgate opens at the touch of a button, and the auto-dimming inside rear-view mirror reduces glare during night driving. Front pedestrian and bicyclist braking adds an important layer of awareness, and comprehensive airbag protection includes dual front, front side, and overhead options.

The Tahoe RST equips you with the features and capability to handle whatever comes your way. Dual zone automatic temperature control keeps all passengers comfortable, rear air conditioning extends climate control to back rows, and the rear window defroster ensures clear visibility in all conditions. The exterior parking camera rear and multiple airbags provide confidence in everyday driving.

Stop by our showroom just south of St. Louis to experience the 2025 Chevrolet Tahoe RST firsthand. Our team is ready to help you find the perfect full-size SUV that matches your lifestyle and needs.

This 2025 GMC Yukon XL Elevation in Black offers the commanding presence and capability you need for every journey, whether navigating city streets or tackling longer drives.

- Second row power-release bucket seats with power-sliding center console
- 16.8" diagonal premium GMC infotainment system with navigation

Advanced safety features include dual front impact and side impact airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and electronic stability control working together to help protect your family.

Inside, the thoughtfully designed cabin balances luxury with practicality. CoreTech perforated leather seating and heated surfaces throughout create a premium driving environment. The illuminated entry, overhead console with garage door transmitter, and multiple storage solutions keep everything organized and within reach. Climate zones, steering wheel controls, and an intuitive interface ensure everyone travels in comfort.

The Preferred Equipment Group 4SA combines practical features with modern convenience. Auto-dimming mirrors, rain-sensing wipers, turn signal indicator mirrors, and fully automatic headlights adapt to driving conditions. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide real-time vehicle information, while the remote keyless entry and security system give you peace of mind.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera with washer - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. Even if there are sloppy conditions, the washer keeps the camera's view clean. Rear camera with washer is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe

This 2025 Ford Expedition Max Platinum in Black represents a premium three-row SUV built to handle both luxury and capability with confidence.

- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 10 speakers
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio
- Heated and ventilated leather front captain's chairs
- Power moonroof with Vista Roof
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated steering wheel
- 2nd row power-folding captain's chairs
- 3rd row split-bench seating with recline capability
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone and rear air conditioning
- 20-inch ebony bright machined aluminum wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Rear parking camera with exterior view
- Dual front and side impact airbags with overhead protection

The Expedition Max Platinum delivers distinctive styling with body-color bumpers, power door mirrors with heating, auto-dimming capability, and turn signal indicators. The exterior parking camera rear provides essential visibility when backing, while the rain-sensing wipers and rear window wiper adapt to weather conditions automatically. A spoiler enhances the vehicle's profile while contributing to aerodynamic efficiency.

Inside, the cabin showcases genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts that complement the leather steering wheel and leather seating surfaces. Memory functions for both the driver's seat and steering wheel position mean you'll enjoy personalized comfort every time you settle in. The heated and ventilated front seats work together with heated rear seats to ensure passenger comfort across all seasons. Power adjustments for the driver and passenger seats, along with telescoping and tilting steering wheel controls, make finding your ideal driving position straightforward.

Technology integration includes a comprehensive navigation system, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls for safe operation while driving. The trip computer, outside temperature display, tachometer, and voltmeter provide essential vehicle information at a glance. Illuminated entry, overhead console, and front and rear reading lights enhance functionality throughout the cabin.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags designed to protect occupants. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and speed-sensing steering enhance vehicle dynamics and predictability. The low tire pressure warning system alerts you to maintain proper inflation, while the 911 Assist emergency communication feature provides peace of mind. A security system and panic alarm add layers of protection.

The twin-turbocharged EcoBoost 3.5L V6 engine paired with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers a balanced combination of performance and capability. The 3.73 axle ratio optimizes power delivery across various driving conditions. Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars contributes to refined handling while maintaining composure on diverse road surfaces.

This Expedition Max Platinum combines spacious three-row seating, advanced comfort appointments, and robust mechanical engineering to meet the demands of families and those who require genuine capability in a luxury package. We invite you to schedule a test drive to experience this vehicle firsthand.

With heated rear seats, rear window defroster, and rear air conditioning, all passengers enjoy climate-controlled comfort regardless of season or seating position.

Safety and connectivity are prioritized through features including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing technology. The OnStar system with GMC Connected Services capability keeps you connected and supported. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to enhance vehicle dynamics and driver confidence.

The combination of thoughtful features, refined styling, and proven performance makes this 2025 GMC Yukon Elevation a compelling choice for those seeking a well-appointed, capable full-size SUV. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the commanding presence and functional design that set this vehicle apart.

- 4WD capability for confident handling in varied driving conditions
- 14-Speaker Premium JBL Audio system for superior sound quality
- Power Tilt/Slide Moonroof with Power Sunshade
- 8-Way Power Seats with driver memory function
- Head-Up Display for convenient instrument visibility
- Blind Spot Monitor with Lane Change Assist
- Pre-Collision System for added safety awareness
- Traffic Jam Assist technology
- Front Cross Traffic Alert
- Fridge with Floor Cover Rear Console Box for convenient storage
- Qi-Compatible Wireless Charging pad
- Digital Key Capability for modern vehicle access
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto smartphone integration
- Navigation system with Drive Connect Cloud Navigation
- Heated and ventilated front seats with leather trim

Powered by a 2.4L 4-Cylinder engine with 8-Speed Automatic transmission, this Land Cruiser delivers 22 city MPG and 25 highway MPG. The 4WD system provides the control you need whether navigating city streets or venturing onto rougher terrain. The combination of performance and efficiency makes this an excellent all-around vehicle choice.

The Premium Package elevates your experience with refinements designed for daily comfort and long-distance travel. Heated seats provide warmth during cooler months, while ventilated seats offer cooling when temperatures rise. The leather seat trim adds a touch of refinement, and the memory seat function ensures your preferred driving position is always just a button away. The electric rear-view mirror and illuminated door sills contribute to both convenience and safety.

Safety features are comprehensive and thoughtfully integrated. The Pre-Collision System, Traffic Jam Assist, and Front Cross Traffic Alert work together to provide awareness and assistance during various driving scenarios. Blind Spot Monitoring with Lane Change Assist helps you navigate confidently in traffic, while the backup camera confirms your surroundings when reversing.

Technology integration ensures your smartphone connects seamlessly through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The navigation system with Drive Connect provides cloud-based routing and information, while Bluetooth connectivity keeps your devices accessible. The heated steering wheel and premium audio system make every drive more enjoyable.

This single-owner Land Cruiser has been maintained by our service department and carries a clean Carfax history with no accidents reported. The 20-inch gray alloy wheels and two-tone body color give this vehicle a distinctive appearance. With thoughtful features throughout and proven Toyota reliability, this Land Cruiser stands ready to meet your needs.

We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this 2025 Toyota Land Cruiser Base firsthand. Our team is prepared to answer your questions and help you explore ownership options that work for your situation.

This 2025 BMW X5 xDrive40i delivers the combination of luxury, performance, and capability that defines the BMW experience. As a BMW Certified Pre-Owned vehicle, it has undergone rigorous inspection and comes backed by comprehensive protection, ensuring your confidence in every drive.

This X5 features a commanding presence with Black Sapphire Metallic exterior paint paired with refined black leather appointments throughout the cabin. Key amenities and technologies include:

- Heated and cooled leather seats with multi-contour support
- Heated steering wheel and front seat armrests for enhanced comfort
- Panoramic moonroof for open-air driving
- Premium Harman/Kardon surround sound system
- Navigation system with live cockpit pro display
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Remote engine start and push button ignition
- Backup camera with surround view and 3D parking display
- Active Park Distance Control with automatic parking assistance
- Blind spot monitoring for enhanced safety awareness
- Four-zone automatic climate control with front ventilated seats
- Gesture control for intuitive cabin management

The 3.0L inline-six engine delivers capable performance while maintaining efficiency, achieving 23 mpg city and 27 mpg highway through the eight-speed automatic transmission. All-wheel drive ensures confident handling in any weather condition, while the sport-tuned suspension and steering provide engaging dynamics paired with responsive comfort.

As a one-owner, local trade-in from a non-smoker, this X5 has been meticulously maintained and carries a clean vehicle history. The premium condition is evident throughout, from the good tires ready for the road to the pristine interior appointments.

Your BMW Certified Pre-Owned coverage includes multipoint inspection, roadside assistance, $0 warranty deductible, and transferable warranty protection. The transferable warranty covers 1 year/unlimited miles beginning after the new car warranty expires, backed by 6 years of roadside assistance. Additionally, enjoy three months of complimentary SiriusXM satellite radio service to enhance your driving experience.

The 2025 BMW X5 xDrive40i represents a significant opportunity to own a luxury performance vehicle with the assurance of BMW Certified Pre-Owned backing. We invite you to experience this exceptional SUV and discover why BMW owners value their vehicles for years to come.

The 2025 GMC Yukon XL Denali in Sterling Metallic Silver represents a sophisticated choice for those seeking a full-size luxury SUV that combines commanding presence with refined interior craftsmanship.

The premium infotainment system integrates navigation, smartphone connectivity, and satellite radio, while the multi-color head-up display keeps essential information within your sight line. The available heated and ventilated leather seating ensures occupant comfort across all seasons, with independent climate zones for driver and passenger preferences.

The suspension architecture combines an independent four-wheel design with Magnetic Ride Control technology, adapting automatically to road conditions and your driving style. Stability and traction systems work seamlessly to maintain control in varied driving situations. Speed-sensing power steering and a tilt-and-telescopic steering column allow personalized control setup.

Safety is integrated throughout, featuring dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. The system includes electronic stability control, traction control, and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS. Rear parking camera assistance supports maneuvering this large SUV with confidence.

The exterior design reflects Denali-level refinement with body-color bumpers, galvano bodyside moldings, heated power door mirrors, and fog lights. The dual exhaust system adds purposeful styling to the rear quarter panels. With three rows of seating and split-folding rear capability, this Yukon XL accommodates up to eight passengers while maintaining flexibility for cargo needs.

We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this Denali firsthand and discuss how it can serve your family's transportation needs.

Offered here is an exceptionally rare 1995 Land Rover Defender 90 Soft Top, finished in its iconic AA Yellow over a black interior and powered by the legendary 3.9L V8 paired with the highly desirable 5-speed manual transmission. With production numbers limited and demand continuing to climb worldwide, authentic North American Specification (NAS) Defender 90 Soft Tops have become some of the most collectible Land Rovers ever built.

This Defender is much more than a survivorit's been thoughtfully upgraded and extensively refreshed with nearly $20,000 invested to enhance both reliability and drivability while preserving everything enthusiasts love about the classic Defender experience.

A substantial amount of work has recently been completed, including nearly $20,000 in documented mechanical, suspension, and restoration upgrades, making this Defender stand out from the average NAS truck.

The North American Specification Defender 90 has become one of the most sought-after collectible SUVs in the world.
